name: acp-find-mcp
description: MCP server for searching the Virtuals Protocol ACP marketplace. Exposes 19 tools — search, compose-stack, agent-reputation (+ history), today, browse-agent, offering deep-dive, compare-agents, watch-status, recent-hires, agent-recent-jobs, search-agents, categories, health, agent-resources, resources-search, resource-call, estimate-stack-cost, agent-feed-address — backed by the public api.acp-metabot.dev gateway. Works in Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, Codex, Continue, Claude Code, and Claude Desktop.
author: Oliver Pringle
